exposure: Maternal hypoglycemia after 50g oral glucose challenge test (OGCT)
cohort: 2623 pregnant patients at 24-28 weeks gestation of a live singleton pregnancy who underwent a 50 g OGCT
finding: Maternal hypoglycemia after a 50g OGCT was significantly associated with an increased SGA rate, decreased 5-minute APGAR scores, and reduced cesarean section rates.
